items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment and approve no incremental AI, infrastructure, marketing, or launch spend this cycle. The fleet has $1,002.46 of AI cost for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,531 calls, versus only $4.92 of Amazon commission reported for 2026-09-21; these windows do not support a margin calculation, but the economics are plainly unproven. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, so do not admit new finance or implementation work until the existing capacity gate clears.

Revenue claims must remain limited to the evidence: Amazon reported 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21. All $4.92 is in the aggregate tracking row 'other'; named site rows total $0 commission. Therefore site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, forecast revenue, and causal lift are unsupported. Do not use sessions, impressions, clicks, conversions, ordered items, or opportunity scores as revenue proxies.

Finance measurement disposition: cost-to-learn is not calculable because AI cost is available by site but not joined to experiment/change exposure, incremental outcomes, or attributable revenue; infrastructure spend is absent because operations/deploy sweeps have no results. Minimum measurement needed before ROI or margin claims: a dated site/change cost ledger joining AI spend, infrastructure cost, exposure, baseline/control outcome, affiliate clicks, ordered and shipped items, commission, and implementation status. Until that exists, retain AI-cost guardrails as a deferred specification and report AI cost separately from revenue.
